subject: [Northwind demo] Decision: Typesense for in-app search
body:
Hi Alice,

Writing this down so it does not get lost in Slack. We are going with Typesense instead of Algolia for in-app search. Reasons: about 70% cheaper at our volume, we can self-host it next to Postgres, and typo tolerance tested as well as Algolia on our product names.

Dave owns the rollout. Target is October 28 behind the search_v2 flag. Still open: how we shard the index once we pass 5 million documents. The full record is in Notion, "Search decision record".

Dave (Northwind Labs, fictional)
